name: Jesting Deflection
body:
Prerequisite(s): Jester level 2nd, Acrobatics 5 ranks

Benefit(s): While wielding a jester prop, you gain a +1 dodge bonus to your Armor Class. This bonus increases to +2 at 10th level. If you are denied your Dexterity bonus to AC, you also lose this dodge bonus.
